sources.snippet: Overview Meta-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct-FP8 is a quantized version of Meta's 70-billion parameter instruction-tuned language model, created by RedHatAI and developed by Neural Magic. The model uses FP8 (8-bit floating point) quantization for both weights and activations across all linear operators in transformer blocks, reducing model size and GPU memory requirements by approximately 50% compared ...
